Indexing strategy for query performance: covering indexes for common access patterns.
tenant_id is indexed on every table.
Composite index marketplace + status on listings for dashboard queries.
Index product_id + created_at for agent run history.
embedding: pgvector IVFFlat or HNSW index on brand_chunks for similarity search.
Index listing_id + date for performance data time-series queries.
Vector Storage page covers pgvector configuration and scaling considerations for brand voice embeddings.
Keywords: vector storage, pgvector, embeddings, scaling
pgvector stores brand voice embeddings alongside relational data.
At MVP scale (thousands of chunks), cosine similarity search is fast.
If retrieval latency becomes an issue at scale (millions of chunks), migrate to a dedicated vector store (Pinecone, Weaviate).
For now, pgvector eliminates operational complexity.

`/analytics` GET purpose: sales attribution (unified with performance).

All endpoints are async (FastAPI + Python async/await).
